Door Supervise Training

A Door Supervisor Training Course is an SIA-approved Level 2 qualification required to apply for an SIA Door Supervisor licence in the UK. It equips learners with the legal knowledge and practical skills needed to work in bars, clubs, events, and licensed venues. Core topics include licensing law, searches, arrests, conflict management, physical intervention, emergency procedures, and customer care. Courses usually last around 6 days and combine classroom or blended learning with multiple-choice

Level 2 Award for Working as a Door Supervisor

The Door Supervisor course is an SIA licence-linked qualification designed for people who want to work in security at pubs, bars, nightclubs, events, festivals and other licensed premises. The current qualification in England, Wales and Northern Ireland is the Level 2 Award for Door Supervisors in the Private Security Industry. You need to complete the qualification and pass the required assessments before applying for an SIA Door Supervisor licence.
